items.title: Repackaged AIvengers VSIX with Cleaned Marketplace Metadata
items.summary:
### 🛠️ Metadata & Packaging Updates

• **Cleaned `package.json` metadata:** Updated `categories` to `["Machine Learning", "Other"]`, trimmed `keywords` to `["workflow", "markdown", "tasks", "collaboration"]`, and removed `"VS Code"` from `description` while preserving `"publisher": "Ianchenyeet"`, `"icon": "media/icon.png"`, `"license": "MIT"`, and all GitHub URLs.

• **Tightened `.vscodeignore`:** Added `.env*` and unused `media/vibe-icon.svg` while confirming exclusion of `node_modules/**`, `.git/**`, `.github/**`, `*.vsix`, `.agents/**`, `.cursor/**`, `.cursorrules`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `archives/**`, and all workspace state/log files.

• **Zero runtime changes:** `extension.js`, `scripts/hub.js`, and `src/roles/roleDefinitions.js` were not modified.

### 🧪 Packaging & Verification

• **`@vscode/vsce@latest` (v4.1.1) `ls`:** Confirmed exactly 10 extension files (`AGENTS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `extension.js`, `LICENSE`, `package.json`, `README.md`, `media/aivengers-icon.svg`, `media/icon.png`, `scripts/hub.js`, `src/roles/roleDefinitions.js`).

• **`@vscode/vsce@latest package`:** Succeeded cleanly with zero warnings and zero errors (`aivengers-1.0.0.vsix`, 12 archive entries, 387.58 KB, SHA-256 `8C9DD103...75E6C`), and synced the identical copy to `C:\Users\user\Downloads\aivengers-1.0.0.vsix`.

• **Manifest inspection:** Verified `<Metadata>` inside `extension.vsixmanifest` reflects the updated `<Categories>`, `<Tags>`, `<Description>`, exact publisher casing `Ianchenyeet`, license, icon, and public GitHub links.
items.nextSteps: Upload the newly repackaged aivengers-1.0.0.vsix to the Visual Studio Marketplace publisher portal.
